title: Why Tiny Friction Changes Behavior
short_teaser: A small extra step, confusing label, or delayed response can reduce completion more than expected.
story: A small extra step, confusing label, or delayed response can reduce completion more than expected. Conversely, removing one obstacle can make action much easier. Behavior is shaped not only by motivation but by the design of the path. Curiosity loosens assumptions. A better question can reveal options that certainty would have hidden. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Behavior is shaped not only by motivation but by the design of the path. Curiosity loosens assumptions. A better question can reveal options that certainty would have hidden.
spark_application: Take one assumption you have been treating as fixed and turn it into three open questions. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
